== Title ==
<span lang="ja">もっとひどい目にあったかも</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">フォースを失う際、Xフォース消費して、失うフォースをX減らすことができる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">監房ブロックAA-23を脱出し、反乱軍はゴミ圧縮装置に出た。レイアは言う。「もっとひどい目にあったかも。」そう、それはこれからだ。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[It Could Be Worse]].

'''Lore''' — After escaping Detention Block AA-23, the Rebels came out into the garbage compactor. Leia says, “It could have been worse.” Well, that is still to come.

'''Game text''' — When you would lose Force, you may spend X Force to reduce the Force you lose by X.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Title is もっとひどい目にあったかも. Lore quotes Leia and says the worse part is still ahead. English lore ends “It soon was”. Game text spends X Force to reduce a Force loss by X.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-L-itcouldbeworse.gif|Original English face]], [[It Could Be Worse]].</ref>
